exclude_from_strategy.YM: Duplicate Dow exposure; retain older ZD series.
exclude_from_strategy.EC: Instrument identity/classification unresolved; omit from strategy rather than assign an unverified class.

funding: Primary: zero-interest synthetic futures-price-return proxy. RF-added results are conditional fully collateralized sensitivities, not verified vendor total returns.
signal: Sign of the sum of the preceding 12 monthly price returns; scaling that window by the same current positive risk estimate leaves its sign unchanged. Zero means flat.
execution: Primary monthly endpoint execution is idealized: history through t-1 determines t exposure at the prior endpoint. A two-month information lag tests one extra full month of execution delay.
missing_data: Require complete trailing signal/risk windows. Never select assets using current/future returns. Raise on any nonzero held exposure with missing realized return; do not fill or silently drop P&L months.
cost_model: Illustrative linear bps per absolute traded notional divided by beginning-month NAV, including initial entry, drift-adjusted monthly rebalancing, RL-to-ER source transition and final liquidation. No bid/ask, market impact, margin, tax or contract-roll cost history is available.
baseline: 12-month trend, trailing correlation-aware risk model, 2% volatility floor, 3x gross cap, 10% forecast risk ceiling, +/-10% trading band; portfolio controls are in config/risk_config.json.
benchmark: STATIC: always long, using the same instrument eligibility, risk model, limits, trading band, and costs; its own forecast determines scaling.
